text: Hello, boys and girls, welcome to Sally's class.First, let's take a look at what we are going to do in today's class.Look at the word on the screen.What is the key to learning?Many people agree that reading is the key to learning.Have you ever thought about the key to reading?I think it depends on what type of article you are reading.Then, how many types of articles have we learned?Three, four.Actually, we have learned four types of articles in our textbooks.They are practical texts, narrative texts,expository texts, and argumentative texts.Do you remember how to tell them from each other?Let's review.First, let's take a look at the practical text.Can you give me any examples of this kind of text?Good, the practical texts we often read are letters,diaries,advertisements,notices,etc.Do they have anything in common?You are right.They have fixed format.The language is concise.Can you think of any examples of the practical texts we have read in our textbooks?Excellent.We have read a letter from trees for life.A student's diary.A job advertisement.And a notice from a hand mistress.Now, let's move on to the narrative text.I'm sure you are quite familiar with this kind of writing.You must have read some wonderful short stories,fables,fairytales,science fiction,detective stories,new stories,etc.They are all narrative texts.Well, how do you know it is a narrative text?Can you think of any features of them?Great.The story usually develops according to the time order.There are also some dialogues and many vivid descriptions in it.While reading this kind of text,we should pay attention to several elements.It's very helpful to follow these elements while reading.Because you will know the characters,the setting,the plot and the theme better.Do you still remember these articles?Jane's driving test.A funny story.Blind man and eyes in fire drama.An exciting true story.Aliens land on our world.A science fiction story.Now, let's talk about another kind of writing.Expository text.Usually,there are three main parts in an expository text.What are they?They are the introduction,the body paragraphs,and the ending.We can figure out what the writer wants to introduce to us in the introduction.Besides,we can know its features by reading the following body paragraphs.Writer is the first person to read the body paragraphs.Writer often writes different types of endings for different purposes.出于不同的写作意图,说明文的结语也不尽相同。有的说明文没有结语。To tell the expository texts from other types of texts,we should focus on the facts.说明文语言严谨,结构清晰,且最重要的是他们陈述事实。We have read several expository texts in our textbooks.Can you remember any of them?It's okay.Let me give you two examples.Do you remember this one?The library.And this one?Think more examples you have read in your textbooks after class.Well,let's move on to the argumentative text.Usually,there are three main parts.Very good.They are the introduction,the body paragraphs,and the conclusion.It looks the same as the expository text.However,they are different.While reading an argumentative text,we can find the writer's point of view in the introduction part.And you will know how the writer presents arguments logically by reading the following paragraphs.At last,the writer summarizes the main points in the conclusion part.What argumentative texts have we read?These two articles make a deep impression on me.They have similar topics.Should we encourage people to keep pets?Is keeping pet dogs a good idea?People have different opinions,and they
